public_gates: unit tests for PPO config validation
unit tests for snippet action anchor loss on outcome snippets
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M228
do not reuse private holdouts for repair
hypothesis: PPO needs the same boundary snippet-level action anchor that stabilized M224/M225 actor updates; adding this loss path to train_ppo should make a later M229 PPO smoke testable without changing actor inputs or loosening gates.
success_criteria: train_ppo config supports a snippet-level action anchor checkpoint, snippet corpus, coefficient, batch size, and preferred-only mode
the snippet action anchor uses boundary outcome snippets rather than rollout-only states
the implementation is covered by focused unit tests
no PPO or driver promotion is claimed in this infrastructure milestone
M229 PPO smoke is pre-registered only after implementation tests pass
failure_criteria: run PPO before the snippet anchor implementation is tested
anchor rejected hidden states by default when the protected recipe requires preferred-only
change the human-view actor input contract

commands.name: implement_snippet_anchor
commands.command: Add train_ppo snippet-action-anchor config fields and loss path, then run focused tests.

decision_rule: M228 may complete only as infrastructure. It may unblock M229 PPO smoke if the snippet-level anchor path is implemented and tested without actor-input changes.
next_blocker: Run one M229 PPO smoke from M224 using rollout action anchor plus preferred-only snippet action anchor, then gate old/current/new replay, behavior, and protected key.
